title: The modulo 9 Kanade--Russell identities and their Nahm-sum duals
summary: Kanade and Russell initiated a family of conjectural Rogers--Ramanujan type identities of moduli $9$ and $12$, which ultimately comprised five modulo $9$ identities and eleven modulo $12$ identities. The eleven modulo $12$ conjectures were subsequently settled through the work of Bringmann, Jennings-Shaffer, and Mahlburg and of Rosengren.
